content:
Currently the leanprover-community default GITHUB_TOKEN is allowed to write, and allowed to merge PRs. We should tighten these up, but a prerequisite is to update all our CI workflows that currently rely on this, by giving them appropriate permissions: blocks.

These are done in the following 9 PRs:

Hopefully relevant maintainers can take care of:

  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/44035
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/batteries/pull/1973
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/blog/pull/141
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib_stats/pull/16

I'll handle

  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/ProofWidgets4/pull/198
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/lean-update/pull/274

And ping individuals for these three:

  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/lean4-metaprogramming-book/pull/213 @Asei Inoue
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/lean4-mode/pull/122 @Mekeor Melire
  • https://github.com/leanprover-community/tutorials4/pull/4 @Patrick Massot
I've merged your mathlib4, blog and mathlib_stats PRs.

Just to check, does your list cover all the fixes that needed under leanprover-community, or should we, for example, check whether we need to fix any of the workflows in ./leanprover-community/physlib?
I audited everything under leanprover-community, so I hope, but don't entirely promise, that I've already covered physlib. Doing some skeptical double checking could not hurt!
All of the above are now merged except batteries#1973 and lean4-mode#122.
I'm going ahead and merging lean4-mode#122, as the repo hasn't been touched in over a year, and it is the last one outstanding here. I'll then tighten the permissions on the default GITHUB_TOKEN.
As far as I am aware no one has observed anything failing as a result of this tightening (or mysterious unexplained CI or bot failures over the last 33 hours)?
Everything looks normal to me so far!
